nodes.title: LOCK SOURCE AUDIO / GENERATE VIDEO ONLY

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Audio 1> is the complete original audio track that must be used as the live spoken performance. All mouth shapes, breathing, emotional intensity, pauses and timing of the main speaker must sync precisely with <Audio 1>.
<Subject 1> is the main speaker whose face, hairstyle, body proportions and overall identity are locked to the primary reference image(s). When multiple images of the same person are provided, they are treated as different outfits / angles / states of the same identity.

summary:
[reference generation + audio performance] A professional13s talking-head / spoken-word video driven by <Audio 1>. The main speaker (<Subject 1>) delivers the content live with natural lip-sync, micro-expressions, head movements and emotional tone that perfectly match <Audio 1>. Multiple reference images are used to control appearance, outfit changes or secondary elements across different segments. Clean cinematic framing, mainly medium shots and close-ups. No logos, no subtitles, no on-screen text unless explicitly requested.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (main speaker): fully_preserved - face, hair and core identity are locked to the primary reference image(s); outfit and styling may change according to additional references.
Additional subjects / elements from Picture 2 … Picture N: fully_preserved or attribute_transfer according to their role (outfit change / secondary character / product / environment).
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - the original audio track is used 1:1 as the live spoken performance; no re-generation of voice.

detailed_description:
[13秒] horizontal 16:9 professional spoken-word / talking-head video. Clean, cinematic lighting. Camera primarily uses medium shots and close-ups to keep focus on the speaker’s face and upper body. The main speaker performs live with natural lip-sync, eye contact, subtle head movements and emotional expressions that follow the rhythm, pauses and intensity of <Audio 1>.

Segment structure 
- Opening segment: <Subject 1> appears in the styling of the first reference image, delivering the beginning of <Audio 1> with clear eye contact and natural expression.
- Middle segment(s): Optional outfit / angle / state changes using additional reference images, or brief appearance of secondary characters / products. Speaker continues the spoken content with matching emotion and lip-sync.
- Closing segment: <Subject 1> (in final styling if changed) delivers the ending of <Audio 1> with a natural concluding expression and pacing.

All transitions are smooth. Clothing and hair remain stable during movement. Face consistency is maintained across every angle and segment.

overall_soundscape:
Only the original <Audio 1> track is heard as the main spoken content. Soft room tone or very light ambient atmosphere may be kept extremely low under the voice if it supports realism. No extra dialogue or overpowering sound effects.

non_diegetic_music:
Optional low-volume background music only if it does not interfere with the clarity of <Audio 1>. By default, keep the focus on the spoken audio.
